data.title: Misk Art Institute Announces Partners for Misk Art Week 2026
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Misk Art Institute, a subsidiary of Mohammed bin Salman Foundation "Misk," announced the partners for the 10th edition of Misk Art Week 2026, which will be held in Riyadh, as part of concerted efforts to support creative talent and enrich Saudi Arabia’s artistic and cultural scene.
    The partners include Saudi National Bank as the main partner, and Arabian Contracting Services Company “Al Arabia” and It's Water as supporting partners. Mohammed bin Salman Nonprofit City “Misk City” will serve as the event's hosting partner.
    Misk City will host the event for the first time since the event's launch in 2017.
    These partnerships reflect efforts to strengthen the presence of the arts in society and contribute to offering a diverse artistic and cultural experience that meets the aspirations of the creative community.
    Misk Art Week 2026 will feature a varied program of art exhibitions, educational programs, artistic experiences and interactive events, allowing visitors to explore creative works, engage with artists and designers, and take part in experiences that bring together art, learning and dialogue.
    -- SPA
